method: Curated aliases are used only to identify candidate semantic matches. A shared concept never proves that two estimates are numerically comparable.

concepts.label: Total population
concepts.definition: Number of people in the stated geography and reference period.
common_traps: Do not combine population estimates, decennial counts, and projections without labeling the series type.

concepts.label: Age
concepts.definition: Age or age group of a person at the source-defined reference time.
common_traps: Age is not the same as an age-adjusted rate.

concepts.label: Sex
concepts.definition: Source-defined sex classification.
common_traps: Do not silently equate sex with gender or gender identity.

concepts.label: Gender or gender identity
concepts.definition: Source-defined gender or gender identity classification.
common_traps: Do not silently equate gender identity with sex assigned at birth.

concepts.label: Race and ethnicity
concepts.definition: Source-defined race and/or Hispanic or Latino ethnicity classification.
common_traps: Mutually exclusive race/ethnicity groups are not equivalent to separate race and ethnicity fields.

concepts.label: Disability
concepts.definition: Source-defined disability status or functional limitation.
common_traps: Survey disability concepts differ from program eligibility and clinical diagnoses.

concepts.label: Median household income
concepts.definition: Median income among households for the stated period and currency year.
common_traps: Current-dollar and inflation-adjusted estimates are not directly comparable.

concepts.label: Per capita income
concepts.definition: Aggregate income divided by the source-defined population.
common_traps: Per capita income is not median household income.

concepts.label: People in poverty
concepts.definition: People below the source-defined poverty threshold.
common_traps: Federal poverty thresholds, guideline eligibility, and ALICE measures are different constructs.

concepts.label: Children in poverty
concepts.definition: Children below the source-defined poverty threshold.
common_traps: Check whether child means under 18, under 17, or another age range.

concepts.label: Unemployment
concepts.definition: People without work who meet the source definition for labor-force participation and job search.
common_traps: Unemployment excludes many people not in the labor force.

concepts.label: Employment
concepts.definition: Source-defined employment status, count, or employment-to-population measure.
common_traps: Jobs by workplace are not the same as employed residents.

concepts.label: Gender pay gap
concepts.definition: Difference or ratio in earnings between source-defined gender groups.
common_traps: A ratio, percentage difference, and dollar gap require different interpretations.

concepts.label: Homeownership
concepts.definition: Owner-occupied housing units as a count or share of occupied units.
common_traps: Homeownership by household differs from the share of people living in owner-occupied homes.

concepts.label: Housing cost burden
concepts.definition: Households spending at least a source-defined share of income on housing costs.
common_traps: Cost burden and severe cost burden use different thresholds.

concepts.label: Severe housing problems
concepts.definition: Composite source measure of severe housing cost burden, crowding, or inadequate facilities.
common_traps: This composite is broader than housing cost burden alone.

concepts.label: Food insecurity
concepts.definition: Source-defined lack of consistent access to enough food for an active, healthy life.
common_traps: Household survey estimates and modeled county estimates are not interchangeable.

concepts.label: Child food insecurity
concepts.definition: Source-defined food insecurity among children.
common_traps: Do not substitute all-person food insecurity for child food insecurity.

concepts.label: Uninsured population
concepts.definition: People without source-defined health insurance coverage.
common_traps: Adult uninsured and total-population uninsured rates use different denominators.

concepts.label: Low birth weight
concepts.definition: Live births below the source-defined birth-weight threshold, commonly 2,500 grams.
common_traps: Very low birth weight is a different threshold.

concepts.label: Preterm birth
concepts.definition: Live births before the source-defined gestational-age threshold, commonly before 37 completed weeks.
common_traps: Obstetric-estimate and last-menstrual-period gestational ages are not identical.

concepts.label: Infant mortality
concepts.definition: Deaths before age one relative to live births, usually expressed per 1,000 live births.
common_traps: Infant deaths are counts; infant mortality is usually a rate.

concepts.label: Teen births
concepts.definition: Birth count, percentage, or rate for a source-defined adolescent age group.
common_traps: Births to people ages 15–19 and the percentage of all births to teens answer different questions.

concepts.label: Maternal mortality
concepts.definition: Pregnancy-associated or pregnancy-related deaths under the source definition.
common_traps: Pregnancy-related and pregnancy-associated deaths are not synonyms.

concepts.label: Prenatal care
concepts.definition: Timing or adequacy of prenatal care under the source measure.
common_traps: First-trimester care and an adequacy index are different measures.

concepts.label: Breastfeeding initiation
concepts.definition: Infants ever breastfed or breastfed at initiation under the source definition.
common_traps: Initiation is not duration or exclusive breastfeeding.

concepts.label: Current adult smoking
concepts.definition: Adults meeting the source definition of current cigarette smoking.
common_traps: Current adult smoking is not smoking during pregnancy or youth tobacco use.

concepts.label: Smoking during pregnancy
concepts.definition: Maternal smoking during a source-defined pregnancy period.
common_traps: Do not compare with adult current-smoking prevalence without preserving the pregnancy universe.

concepts.label: Youth tobacco use
concepts.definition: Use of cigarettes, vaping products, or other tobacco products among a source-defined youth population.
common_traps: Cigarette, any-tobacco, and electronic-vapor measures are distinct.

concepts.label: Physical inactivity
concepts.definition: No leisure-time physical activity or another source-defined inactivity measure.
common_traps: Inactivity and failure to meet activity guidelines are not always equivalent.

concepts.label: Adult obesity
concepts.definition: Adults meeting the source-defined obesity threshold, commonly body mass index at least 30 kg/m².
comparison_dimensions: self-reported versus measured height and weight
common_traps: Adult obesity and childhood obesity use different measures and growth references.

concepts.label: Diabetes
concepts.definition: Source-defined diagnosed diabetes prevalence or diabetes outcome.
common_traps: Diabetes prevalence is not diabetes mortality.

concepts.label: Hypertension
concepts.definition: Source-defined high blood pressure or diagnosed hypertension.
common_traps: Clinical thresholds have changed over time.

concepts.label: Asthma
concepts.definition: Source-defined current or lifetime asthma prevalence.
common_traps: Current asthma and ever-diagnosed asthma use different numerators.

concepts.label: Depression
concepts.definition: Source-defined depressive symptoms, diagnosis, or episode.
common_traps: Postpartum depression, diagnosed depression, and symptom screens are not interchangeable.

concepts.label: Frequent mental distress
concepts.definition: Poor mental health for a source-defined number of days, commonly at least 14 of the past 30 days.
common_traps: Frequent mental distress is not a clinical diagnosis of depression.

concepts.label: Suicide mortality
concepts.definition: Deaths classified as suicide under the source coding rules.
common_traps: Suicide deaths are not suicide attempts or suicidal ideation.

concepts.label: Mental health providers
concepts.definition: Count or population-to-provider ratio for source-defined mental health professionals.
aliases: population to mental health provider ratio
common_traps: A provider count, providers per population, and population-per-provider ratio are different units.

concepts.label: High school graduation
concepts.definition: Students graduating under a source-defined cohort graduation measure.
common_traps: Cohort graduation is not adult educational attainment.

concepts.label: High school completion or attainment
concepts.definition: People with a high school diploma or equivalent under the source-defined attainment universe.
common_traps: Adult attainment is not a school cohort graduation rate.

concepts.label: College enrollment
concepts.definition: People or graduates enrolled in postsecondary education under the source definition.
common_traps: Population enrollment and immediate postsecondary enrollment of graduates differ.

concepts.label: Violent crime
concepts.definition: Offenses included in the source-defined violent-crime category.
common_traps: Police-reported crime does not measure all victimization.

concepts.label: Robbery
concepts.definition: Robbery offenses, arrests, or victimizations under the source definition.
common_traps: Robbery is distinct from burglary.

concepts.label: Sexual violence
concepts.definition: Source-defined sexual violence, assault, or victimization measure.
common_traps: Police reports and victimization surveys measure different portions of harm.

concepts.label: Homicide
concepts.definition: Deaths or criminal offenses classified as homicide under source rules.
common_traps: Vital-statistics homicide and police-recorded murder are related but not identical series.

concepts.label: People experiencing homelessness
concepts.definition: People counted as experiencing homelessness under the source-defined point-in-time or annual measure.
common_traps: Point-in-time counts are one-night estimates and do not equal annual service use.

concepts.label: Childhood vaccination coverage
concepts.definition: Children receiving a source-defined vaccine or vaccine series by a specified age.
common_traps: Individual vaccines and combined series are not interchangeable.

concepts.label: Injury mortality
concepts.definition: Deaths caused by source-defined injury mechanisms or intents.
common_traps: Injury mortality and injury hospitalization measure different severity and populations.

concepts.label: Cancer incidence
concepts.definition: New cancer cases under registry site, behavior, and case-definition rules.
common_traps: Incidence is not prevalence or mortality.

concepts.label: Cancer mortality
concepts.definition: Deaths with a source-defined cancer as the underlying cause.
common_traps: Cancer mortality is not cancer incidence.

concepts.label: Age-adjusted all-cause mortality
concepts.definition: Deaths from all causes expressed as a rate standardized to a stated age distribution.
common_traps: An all-cause age-adjusted rate is not a crude rate or a cause-specific rate.

concepts.label: Premature death
concepts.definition: Deaths occurring before a source-defined age or years of potential life lost before that age.
common_traps: A premature-death count, a rate, and YPLL are different measures even when a dashboard gives them the same short label.

concepts.label: Child mortality
concepts.definition: Deaths among children in a source-defined age range.
common_traps: Child mortality is not infant mortality; sources may use under 18, ages 1–19, or another age range.

concepts.label: Children with special health care needs
concepts.definition: Children meeting a source-defined screener or service-need definition for ongoing health conditions.
aliases: children with special health care needs
child with special health care needs
common_traps: This survey construct is not the same as disability status, a diagnosis, or program eligibility.

concepts.label: Arthritis
concepts.definition: Source-defined diagnosed arthritis or related joint condition.
common_traps: Self-reported clinician diagnosis is not the same as claims-based or clinical prevalence.

concepts.label: Frequent physical distress
concepts.definition: Poor physical health for a source-defined number of days, commonly at least 14 of the past 30 days.
common_traps: Frequent physical distress is not the same as disability or a specific chronic condition.

concepts.label: High cholesterol
concepts.definition: Source-defined elevated blood cholesterol, usually based on a clinician statement or measured threshold.
common_traps: A diagnosis question and a laboratory threshold do not identify the same numerator.

concepts.label: Insufficient sleep
concepts.definition: Sleep duration below a source-defined threshold during a stated reference period.
common_traps: Adult and youth sleep recommendations and questionnaire wording differ.

concepts.label: Income inequality
concepts.definition: Dispersion in income summarized using a source-defined ratio or index.
common_traps: A Gini coefficient and an 80th-to-20th-percentile ratio are not interchangeable.

concepts.label: Drinking water violations
concepts.definition: Population, systems, or time subject to source-defined health-related drinking-water violations.
common_traps: A violation indicator is not a measured contaminant concentration or proof of individual exposure.

concepts.label: Fair or poor health
concepts.definition: Adults rating their general health as fair or poor under the source questionnaire.
aliases: self reported fair or poor health
common_traps: Some sources publish the inverse—good or better health—so direction must be checked.
